separation: 45 ft / ~13.7 m, through a thick cement wall, a wooden door, and a large wooden cupboard in the receiving room
prediction_miss: The RSSI prediction recorded BEFORE the run was -65 to -80 dBm. Actual was -52 to -61. The estimate was too pessimistic: the cement wall cost materially less than assumed. Recorded as a miss rather than dropped, because a prediction is only worth writing down if the failures are kept too.
margin_note: At about -55 dBm against a sensitivity near -120 dBm there is roughly 65 dB of margin left. SNR held at 8-9 dB, indistinguishable from the desk test, so the wall degraded signal strength without degrading the link quality.
redundancy_behaviour: Passes 2 and 3 arrived after completion and show pending={} -- nothing was re-emitted or corrupted. Repetition was not needed at this range but the design tolerated it correctly.
receiver_validation: The receiver checked proof-of-work LOCALLY, with no network, and never trusted the transmitter for a byte. That is what makes this a result rather than a file copy.
what_this_establishes: The block did not exist anywhere when the receiver was air-gapped at 15:54:06Z; it was mined at 16:12:05Z and appeared on that machine at 16:15Z. It cannot have been pre-staged, cached or synced. The radio is the only channel by which it could have arrived.
